inspiration.author: Gleb Kuznetsov
inspiration.caption: Gen UI thinking..
inspiration.captureMethod: Cropped browser screenshots of the publicly visible video; no video download.

scope: Four static desktop/phone image studies, preserving Hermes/Roky identity; no application changes.

directions.name: Pearl Home
directions.summary: Pearlescent home, one dominant context card and pill composer
directions.prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup. Create a high-fidelity Hermes Studio product design concept in the SPECIFIC visual language of the supplied Gleb Kuznetsov "Gen UI thinking" video frames. The user explicitly chose that video as the design inspiration. Study it carefully and transfer its material, spacing, typography and contextual composition into OUR product, rather than decorating an unchanged conventional dashboard.
INPUTS:
1. Actual video frame at 5 seconds: PRIMARY STYLE reference. Pearl-white luminous canvas, extremely soft diffuse blue and warm light, light regular typography, large pill controls, quietly frosted context card.
2. Actual video frame at 25 seconds: SECOND STYLE/SPATIAL reference. Isolated floating context cards linked with fine hairlines, airy open conversation, tiny circular identity tokens, soft translucent pills.
3. Selected Hermes Studio Graphite & Amber UI: PRODUCT AND IDENTITY reference, not a rigid layout template for this new study.
4. Approved Roky variant catalogue: CHARACTER reference. Use these real faceted stone characters consistently.
DO NOT copy the iPhone hardware, Tokyo/travel photographs, Amelia name, airport content, human profile photos, video player or physical set from the reference. We want the DESIGN LANGUAGE applied to Hermes Studio. No plants, fish, invented animals or unrelated mascot illustrations.
COMPOSITION: landscape 3:2 board, one LARGE desktop application screenshot occupying about 72% width and one matching iPhone-size APP SCREEN occupying 25%, with a narrow gutter and a small concept number/name. Both flat and straight-on, no perspective, device shell, mockup photography, camera/notch, laptop or decorative character poster. Desktop and phone share precisely the same style. Show enough real functional UI to evaluate. The interface should fill the image, not float as a tiny card on a huge marketing background.
THE REFERENCE LOOK: near-white PEARLESCENT atmosphere, diffuse ice-blue/cyan light with a very soft peach/amber optical reflection in a small area, luminous translucent white sheets, almost invisible soft edges, large smooth rounded corners and oversized composer pills. Selected graphite control accents and tiny amber activity cues. Delicate continuous layering, no heavy outlines, hard drop shadows or rigid dense box grids. A few tiny circular identity tokens and fine connecting lines. Light REGULAR-WEIGHT native modern sans typography, thoughtful line breaks, dark legible text; no bold giant display serif, brush type, bitmap font or illustration style. The background color should feel like softly moving light through white glass, not flat solid tint or generic rainbow wallpaper. Keep reading regions nearly white with excellent text contrast. Avoid beige/cream/sepia or predominantly purple/lavender background; any iridescence must stay subtle and pearly.
OUR PRODUCT: "Hermes Studio", navigation "Dashboard", "Bots", "Team rooms", "Routines", "Settings"; persistent teammates Atlas / Chief of staff, Nova / Creative partner, Scout / Research analyst, Echo / Writing partner. Actual capabilities include chat, Memory, Files, Skills, team collaboration and document outputs. Keep existing names and functions recognizable even when navigation becomes a quieter compact glass rail/pill. The phone has compact bottom navigation, large touch targets and no cramped desktop sidebar.
ROKY IDENTITY: Atlas = Basalt dark graphite, Nova = Pearl white, Scout = Cobalt blue, Echo = Ember orange with happy curved eye marks, from Input 4. Use HEAD portraits in small avatar tokens and roster controls, not full-body stickers everywhere. Keep the faceted rock construction, recessed warm eye marks and small orange side insert. One compact full-body Roky may appear only in a welcome/profile area, with original sneakers. Do not invent robots or change characters into glass orbs. Keep avatars small enough that the exquisite UI remains the focus.
CONTENT HONESTY: this is a static DESIGN PREVIEW with illustrative content, not a screenshot of a real completed task. Use draft/preview labels where showing sample documents or proposed work. No fake metrics, fake live activity claims or invented real account data. Add tiny unobtrusive "Design preview" outside the app frames. Do not show private/internal reasoning text. Point clouds and connecting traces are visual activity elements; they contain no hidden thought text.
Render as a beautiful practical application, with the exact soft material/typographic restraint from the video.
CONCEPT 01 / PEARL HOME. Closest to the 5-second video frame.
DESKTOP: a calm slim white-glass navigation rail on the left with the real five sections, compact Roky teammate tokens nearby. The main canvas is mostly open pearl-white space with a regular-weight "Your team, ready when you are" greeting in the upper-middle. Beneath it, ONE dominant softly frosted context card "Continue with Echo" / "Writing partner" / "Plan the week ahead", a small orange Echo head token on its edge, and two smaller quieter cards "Memory" and "Files". Use a discreet pill segmented teammate switcher with four named Roky portraits above the greeting. A large low rounded floating bottom composer says "Message Echo…" with separate circular attach and microphone/send controls, echoing the reference. The warm/cool light is most visible around the open canvas and card perimeter, not under text.
PHONE: greeting at upper-middle, small avatar/team pill across the top, one dominant context card above a two-part bottom composer; four tiny bottom navigation symbols match the real product. A small relaxed orange Echo full-body character can sit in the open area as a subtle product identity, far smaller than the card. Preserve airy breathing room, thin type, and sophisticated ambient color. No stacked dashboard analytics or four identical bot cards.

CONCEPT 02 / OPEN CONVERSATION. Closest to the 15-second video frame.
DESKTOP: an airy open Echo CHAT with a quiet slim left rail containing navigation and four small Roky portraits. At the top of the center canvas, one small floating context card "Weekly priorities / Draft" almost recedes into white glass. The current readable exchange is centered in generous empty space: user "Help me plan next week." and Echo "Let's start with your priorities." Use dark regular-weight type around 22px, not a giant greeting or speech-bubble clutter. Beneath the current exchange sits a very subtle white/silver POINT-CLOUD DISC, like the video, with one tiny amber status dot and label "Ready". A small orange Echo portrait identifies the assistant; don't place a huge mascot in the center. Bottom composer is one oversized translucent white pill with a distinct charcoal circular send action and small amber edge light. A tiny right-side Files/Memory glass capsule may float quietly.
PHONE: the same one current exchange is centered in open pearl space, earlier draft context is a compact card near the top, faint point-cloud disc beneath the response and spacious two-part composer at bottom. Small bottom navigation and a clear Echo name/portrait. No system keyboard, physical iPhone shell, travel content or human photo avatars. Let the background feel continuous from desktop to phone with airy white, pale blue and a small amber optical glow.

Round corners and shadows are almost invisible, as in the video. Elegant regular-weight black typography, generous line spacing. No photographic travel background, no animal artwork, no fake completed export/download claim.
